title: T1055 — Process Injection
subtitle: Interactive walkthrough of Process Injection with the technique-specific attack path and defender evidence.

steps.defender: Sysmon EventID 1 shows Winword.exe spawning cmd.exe and powershell.exe - a suspicious process tree.
